rumours: Griffins strike back at every attacker, however many come at them in a round.
The richest mines are always guarded by the hungriest monsters.
An archer with an enemy at its side shoots at half its strength.
Dwellings fill again at the start of every week, so a patient lord never lacks an army.
Angels fear nothing, and they hit hardest of all the creatures of the Castle.
A hero who reaches a new level grows stronger in attack, defense, power or knowledge.
